name: Minneapolis, MN
subtitle: The Upper Midwest's most underrated food city
items: Spoon and Stable (Gavin Kaysen, North Loop — James Beard winner, worth every penny)
Owamni (Sean Sherman, Indigenous cuisine, James Beard Outstanding Restaurant 2022)
Young Joni (Ann Kim, NE Mpls, pizza + Korean influences — James Beard winner)
Alma (Alexander Roberts, SE, French-influenced, 25+ years of excellence)
Hai Hai (NE, Vietnamese + cocktails, Christina Nguyen — James Beard nom.)
Travail Kitchen (Robbinsdale, collaborative kitchen — theater + food)
The Bachelor Farmer (N Loop, local/Nordic, Marvel Bar downstairs)
Brasa Rotisserie (N Loop + Seward, rotisserie + Southern sides)
Quang Restaurant (Eat Street, Vietnamese — the bánh mì + phở institution)
Red Cow (multiple, best burger in Twin Cities)
Butcher & the Boar (Downtown, sausage + brews + patio)
Tilia (Linden Hills, neighborhood gem, Steve Brown)
Zen Box Izakaya (Downtown, Japanese pub food)
Surly Brewing Co. (Surly Destination Brewery, best brewery restaurant in Midwest)
Revival (Multiple, fried chicken — the best in the state)
